title: 2027 Retirement Actuarial Graduate Trainee Consultant Programme, Dublin
description: **Description** With 49,000\+ colleagues in over 140 countries, we help organisations make forward\-thinking choices about their people, their investments and the risks they face. Joining our Retirement team, you’ll be part of our impact right from the start. Our Retirement team work with some of the largest occupational pension schemes in the UK. Advising on both Defined Benefit and Defined Contribution schemes, we tackle complex challenges every day and make a real difference to active and retired employees across the country. Our work is vital and often very high profile. As a trainee consultant who’s ready to start making an impact, you’ll enjoy a range of generous benefits and opportunities to develop your skills, network and career. At WTW, we believe difference makes us stronger. We want our workforce to reflect the different and varied markets we operate in and to build a culture of inclusivity that makes colleagues feel welcome, valued and empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive work environment throughout our organisation. We embrace all types of diversity. **Responsibilities** Working with and learning from some of the leading figures in the pensions industry, you’ll help deliver innovative solutions for prestigious clients. You’ll also be supported through your actuarial exams, with a mentor and a comprehensive and flexible study support package to help you become a Fellow of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries. **On Our Programme, You’ll** * Focus on supporting clients with their Defined Benefit schemes, although there may be opportunities to work with other types of schemes * Support with everything from regular valuation work to cutting\-edge risk\-reduction and scheme design projects * Work with teams such as investment, communications and administration to provide joined\-up advice * Build your technical and consulting skills through a mix of practical and classroom learning * Solve real\-world actuarial problems that matter to our clients * Gain the skills to effectively communicate the results of your work to colleagues and clients * Be encouraged to identify opportunities to improve the way we work and the services we provide **Qualifications** **Requirements:** To transform your tomorrow as a trainee consultant, you’ll need: * 2:1 degree in a numerate discipline or 2:1 in a non\-numerate discipline * To be ready to learn and contribute * A good head for numbers * Excellent communication skills * To be excited by solving challenging technical problems **Closing Date:** 30th September 2026 **Workstyles** We’re open to hybrid working for this role, which means blending working at home with days in the office, collaborating with and learning from the people around you. **The Application Process** Stage 1: Apply online and attach your CV Stage 2: Invitation to complete an online assessment and a video interview Stage 3: Attend a virtual /face to face interview, where you’ll meet members of the team Stage 4: Offer and acceptance Stage 5: Joining us and a welcoming onboarding process to get you up and running We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidate.helpdesk@wtwco.com We are committed to maintaining a fair and equitable process for all candidates – read our AI Guidance.

title: AI Curious Digital Advertising Specialist (3-Month Fixed-Term Contract)
description: We've gone AI mad at Kubicle. We have to. It's what we teach other companies to do. In the last six months we've automated most of our marketing stack. We can spin up high\-performing landing pages in an hour. We generate on\-brand collateral tailored to niche audiences. We've started automating parts of our bidding strategy. And we feel we're only getting started. We need someone with real digital advertising and SEO expertise to take this further. AI is a tool. The impact comes from pairing the right tool with the right knowledge. This is a 3\-month contract to build a predictable, repeatable and scalable B2B lead acquisition channel. You'll have an advertising budget of up to €7,000 per month and all the AI credits you need to make it happen. **About Kubicle** Kubicle helps professional services, banking and finance teams build data and AI skills. We've built our reputation with top consultancies, Big Four firms and major financial institutions, and we're now expanding into new markets. We're about to launch the biggest product in our history, one that could reshape Kubicle over the next few years. We're backing it with real budget and real intent, and we need someone to help drive its go\-to\-market. **What you'll deliver** 1. Resolve our key attribution issues and build clear tracking and reporting. 2. Build effective, potentially autonomous, bidding strategies and tooling to improve campaign management. 3. Improve our website's SEO and landing page conversion using PostHog observability, and introduce automations or triggers that flag design improvements. 4. Explore new AI approaches. We're open to other tools, but expect most of the work to be done with Claude Code or Claude agents. The overall goal: a digital advertising engine that is repeatable, scalable and predictable, with a clear ROI model behind it. **Who you are** *You know AI.* If you haven't built things with Claude Code or worked in the command line with Claude, this role probably isn't for you. We're not looking for an engineer, but we are looking for someone who uses AI tools to supercharge their work. *You know digital advertising.* Tools are one thing, knowledge is another. You can build a campaign in Google Ads or LinkedIn the old\-school way. AI can do it for you, but you need to understand attribution well enough to fix it yourself. You'll also bring: * Hands\-on experience in digital advertising or performance marketing, ideally including a product launch or go\-to\-market * Real comfort with Google Analytics, paid platforms and attribution * The business maturity to understand positioning and strategy, not just execute in isolation * A sharp, hungry mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and a desire to be in the room * An insatiable appetite for AI and the knowledge to explore it productively **The details** * 3\-month contract, in our Dublin office 4 days a week * Rate: approx. €5,000 to €6,000 per month, depending on experience * If the milestones are met and a clear ROI model is established, this could become a full\-time role * Start date: ASAP (PS \- Some things should't be written by AI. Job ads are one of them. We've used AI to polish up grammar, but not write the ad ;) )

title: AML/CFT Consultant
description: Dublin **About RSM** RSM Ireland is one of the country’s fastest growing advisory firms, specialising in the provision of consulting, audit and tax services to leading domestic and international mid\-market clients. We are a key member of the RSM International network where we collaborate with over 64,000 colleagues across 820 offices in 120 countries. RSM International is recognised as the fastest\-growing accountancy network worldwide and is currently ranked sixth globally. When you join RSM you’ll have a world of opportunity to build the career you want. It’s your future. Own it at RSM. **About The Role** RSM Ireland is seeking an AML/CFT Consultant to support our growing financial crime advisory offering. You will deliver AML/CFT reviews, risk assessments, and compliance testing across regulated entities, including banks, payment firms, crypto\-asset service providers, and investment firms. **Responsibilities Include** * Conduct AML/CFT risk assessments and control reviews. * Evaluate policies, procedures, and transaction monitoring frameworks. * Support independent assurance reviews and regulatory readiness assessments. * Draft reports and present findings to clients. * Assist with remediation planning and implementation. * Stay current on AML/CFT regulations (e.g. EU AML Package, CBI guidance, FATF). * Contribute to proposals and thought leadership. **The Person** The successful candidate will ideally have the following skills and qualifications: * 3\-4 years’ experience in AML/CFT, financial crime, or regulatory compliance * Professional qualification (e.g. ICA, ACAMS, or legal/regulatory background) * Strong understanding of AML/CFT frameworks and risk typologies. * Experience in financial services or consulting * Excellent analytical and communication skills * Ability to work independently and manage multiple engagements *RSM is an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Business Graduate Pathways
description: Job Description Step into a career with purpose \- daa's Business Pathways Graduate Programme is a two\-year journey for ambitious graduates ready to shape Ireland's connectivity and help connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. daa is a global airport and travel retail group with operations across 13 countries. title: CRM Executive
description: Travel Department is Ireland’s leading escorted tour operator with an approach to business that is innovative, dynamic and professional. We have an unsurpassed reputation within our market for excellent customer service, quality holidays and value. For over 30 years, our team of experts have been creating fully guided group holidays with best\-in\-class service and an ever\-growing product portfolio. We have an exciting opportunity for a **CRM Executive.** **Role Purpose** The CRM Executive is responsible for the day\-to\-day management, optimisation and effective use of HubSpot as the central platform for CRM, email marketing and marketing automation. The role focuses on customer data, segmentation, campaign delivery, lifecycle communications, reporting and continuous improvement to support customer engagement, retention and conversion. You would report directly to our Marketing Manager. **Key Responsibilities:** **HubSpot CRM Management and Governance** * Maintain and optimise HubSpot marketing assets and processes, including contact properties, lists, workflows, forms, campaign records, email templates and reporting assets. * Maintain high standards of CRM data quality through regular data hygiene, deduplication, validation, suppression management and quality checks. * Ensure consent, subscription preferences, suppression rules and data\-retention requirements are correctly applied across CRM audiences and campaigns. * Maintain clear naming conventions, documentation and quality\-assurance processes across campaigns, lists, workflows and email assets. * Monitor HubSpot performance and identify system, data or process issues that may affect CRM or email marketing activity. * Provide first\-line HubSpot support and CRM guidance to the Marketing Team and all relevant stakeholders within the company. **Email Marketing and Campaign Delivery** * Build, test, schedule and deploy email campaigns in HubSpot using approved campaign briefs, copy and creative assets. * Manage audience selection, segmentation, exclusions, personalisation, testing, tracking and campaign set\-up to ensure accurate and effective delivery. * Maintain and share reusable email templates, modules and designs to support consistent and efficient campaign delivery. * Monitor email deliverability and campaign performance, including delivery, open, click\-through, conversion, bounce and unsubscribe rates. * Use campaign results, audience behaviour and testing to recommend improvements to targeting, content, timing and customer journeys. * Work with the Marketing Team and relevant stakeholders to support priority campaigns, products and tours. **Marketing Automation and Lifecycle Communications** * Manage, test and optimise automated and triggered programmes in HubSpot across the customer lifecycle, including but not limited to Abandon Browse, Abandon Basket, Enquiry, Welcome Series, Pre\-Trip, Post\-Trip/Post\-Sale, Birthday and Anniversary communications. * Review workflow logic, enrolment criteria, suppression rules, timing, personalisation and customer journeys to ensure automations remain accurate and effective. * Develop and update workflows where agreed to improve performance and refresh creative. * Monitor automation performance, investigate issues and implement agreed improvements. **Segmentation, Customer Data and DM Support** * Create and maintain customer segments and campaign audiences using demographic, behavioural, engagement, booking and lifecycle data. * Translate campaign objectives into clear audience criteria, exclusions and estimated audience volumes. * Analyse customer profiles and segments to identify behavioural patterns, engagement trends and opportunities for improved targeting and personalisation. * For direct mail campaigns, provide CRM and data support including data extraction, analysis, cleansing, deduplication, validation, segmentation, formatting and secure preparation of campaign data. * Support audience profiling and direct mail campaign analysis where relevant response and customer data is available within HubSpot. * Creative development, production planning, print and mailing\-house management, campaign schedules and budgets sit outside the scope of this role. **CRM Reporting, Dashboards and Insights** * Build, maintain and continually improve HubSpot dashboards and reporting suites covering email marketing, automated customer journeys, customer engagement, database health and overall CRM performance. * Monitor and report on agreed CRM and email marketing KPIs, including campaign engagement, conversion, deliverability, database growth, subscription trends and workflow performance. * Analyse customer profiles, segment composition, booking behaviour, engagement patterns and lifecycle trends. * Share regular CRM and email marketing performance updates with the wider Marketing Team and relevant stakeholders. * Provide clear insights and recommendations to support campaign planning, targeting, personalisation, retention and conversion. * Provide ad hoc CRM analysis where required to support campaign planning and business decision\-making. * Monitor the overall operational health of HubSpot, including data quality, workflow performance, reporting accuracy, deliverability and database engagement. **Partnerships and Travel Agent Support** * Support Partnership and Travel Agent marketing activity when required from a CRM and marketing perspective. * Provide support with HubSpot campaign set\-up, audience segmentation, customer data, email templates and CRM reporting. * Share relevant CRM insights, templates and campaign learnings that can support partnership and Travel Agent activity. * Provide CRM guidance and assistance where required, while ownership of the wider partnership and Travel Agent marketing activity sits outside the core scope of the CRM Specialist role. **We would like you to have:** * 2 to 4 years’ experience in CRM, email marketing or a similar digital marketing role. * Experience using an email marketing or CRM platform important, HubSpot experience is preferable but not essential. * Experience building, testing and deploying email campaigns, including segmentation and audience management. * Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with customer data and campaign set\-up. * Good analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign performance and customer insights. * Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. * Comfortable working under pressure in a fast\-paced environment. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with different teams and stakeholders. * Collaborative, proactive and solutions\-focused with a strong team\-player mindset. **Package details for the right candidate:** * Full\-time permanent role * Working days, Monday to Friday. Hybrid working arrangement * 20 days annual leave per year * Position based in Dublin, served by many transport links with flexibility for a blend of home and office working * Dynamic and exciting industry and work environment If you would like to apply for this role, please email a short cover letter along with your CV to Marketing Manager at ciaramg @traveldepartment.ie The closing date for applications is 09/10/2026\. Only applicants who are selected for interview will be contacted.

description: **The Company:** Prodieco is not only the largest provider of high\-performance blister tooling change parts for the pharmaceutical industry. It is a mindset that leads us to pursue quality operational excellence and precision in everything that we do Our ethos is simple – **There is always a better way.** You see this in our continuous drive for internal process improvement but more importantly the dedication to enhancing every tool design to produce the perfect blister pack. **Role Overview:** We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented CNC Machine Operator with experience in Laser or Waterjet cutting to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for setting up, programming and operating CNC Laser and Waterjet cutting machines to produce high\-quality parts in accordance with design drawings and production requirements. The role will involve ensuring machines are set up and operated safely and efficiently, while maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy. **Key Duties/Responsibilities:** * Set up and operate CNC Laser, Waterjet and SAW equipment in accordance with work orders, blueprints and production schedules. * Program, adjust, download, modify and enter machine programs as required. * Adjust machine setting, laser focal points, waterjet pressure, abrasive flow and cutting speeds to optimise performance and part yield. * Load and unload raw materials, ensuring materials are handled safely and correctly (sheet metal, steel plate etc) * Carry out first\-piece inspections using appropriate measuring tools and equipment to verify dimensions and quality requirements. * Monitor cutting operations to identify and address quality issues, including taper, inconsistent edge conditions and other defects. * Maintain accurate records of production runs, material usage , quality checks and completed programs * Carry out routine maintenance and basic troubleshooting of equipment to support efficient and reliable machine operation. **Key Performance Indicators:** * Right first\-time production * Achievement of efficiency metrics **Skills and Attributes:** * Minimum of 1 years experience operating a Laser Cutting Machine or Water Jet is an essential requirement * Programming experience using G\-Codes and M\-Codes * Skill in operating CNC machinery and tooling as well as precision measurement tools * Experience in one off/ prototyping environment. * Ability to read and interpret mechanical documents and drawings * Computer savvy with basic understanding of computer programming and CAD/CAM * Mechanical aptitude and good math skills * A keen eye for detail and results\-driven approach **Benefits:** * On – Site Parking * Quarterly Bonus * Monthly Company Events * Early Finish Friday’s * Bike to Work Scheme * Refer a Friend up to €1,500 * Maternity/Paternity Top Up

title: Content Marketing Specialist (6 Month Fixed-Term Contract)
description: **About Us** At Fenergo, we're not just building software—we're transforming how the world's leading financial institutions fight financial crime. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti\-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren't just compliant—they're confident. Where technology doesn't just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world. Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We're tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind. Join us, and be part of a team that's building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together. **Overview Of Role** This is a fantastic opportunity to learn new skills and develop an exciting career in content marketing and communications. The Content Marketing Specialist will join a small team focused on owning Fenergo's corporate voice and creating compelling, persuasive and informative content. You will be a highly motivated and enthusiastic individual, who can write across a myriad of mediums and channels, offering key messages to different buyer personas. You will be capable of translating complex technology\-based content into compelling stories that fuel our lead lifecycle process. Your role will span support content marketing, PR and analyst relations, allowing you to expand your experience and skillset across these critical communications divisions. Please note this is a Fixed Term Contract for a period of 6 months. **Key Responsibilities** **Content Marketing** * Manage content calendar to show forward plan of content and alignment to key priorities * Support Content and Comms Director with the development of whitepapers, blogs, case studies * Support with writing landing page and web content (descriptions etc) of videos, case studies and awards * Leverage AI tools to summarise webinars and long\-form content (research reports etc) for blogs * Support in writing and submitting speaking proposals for major events * Responsible for collating monthly reports including metrics for content pieces **Public Relations and Analyst Relations** * Manage an annual global awards calendar including writing and submitting award entries, purchasing logos for award wins, publishing of award wins on website and all internal and external promotion * Coordinate effective promotion of analyst rankings internally and externally via various channels including social media, website, intranet etc. This includes writing relevant promo content for all channels * Support with logistics for annual events in key locations * Tracking and reporting of media coverage — partner with PR agency to report on impact of comms activity **Requirements** **Experience** * 1\-2 years' experience in public relations or content marketing, gained in earned and owned channels * Experience working with senior stakeholders and contributors **Skills** * Strong team player with a collaborative mindset * Excellent time management and organisational skills * Highly effective interpersonal and communication skills * Outstanding writing ability that informs, educates, and persuades * Ability to combine creative thinking with commercial and product understanding * Skilled in writing across multiple formats (digital, social, print) and for a variety of audiences and personas * Strong attention to detail, with a passion for delivering high\-quality, outcome\-focused work **Nice to Have** * A degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field **Benefits** **Our promise to you** We are striving to become global leaders title: Credit & Collections Analyst, French Speaker
description: Bentley Systems **Location:** Dublin (Hybrid/Office\-Based) **Position Summary** Our Credit \& Collections Team is seeking an analyst to join our shared service center. This person will have excellent communication skills and be extremely organized. This is a great opportunity to join a collaborative team and develop your career within a multinational software company. **Responsibilities** **Native French and fluent English required.** * Collect cash for a ledger of accounts receivables in EMEA. * Ensure that cash targets are met, and payment terms are respected. * Keep overdue and DSO under control and to the minimum. * Contact clients by phone and email regularly to confirm payment of invoices. * Record contact activity and invoice status in Workday. * Escalate issues to Credit and Collections Management and Account Managers when their intervention or awareness is required. * Create a document and follow up on dispute cases in Workday and Salesforce. * Perform account reconciliation to ensure that outstanding balances are correct. * Review unapplied credits and handle refund requests. * Address, reply and resolve queries of users by phone, email, and Service Now. **Qualifications** * Native French and fluent English required. * Degree in Business Administration or Finance preferred, or equivalent experience. * Attention to detail and very organized. * Proficiency in Excel, Word, and Outlook required. * Strong communication skills. * Results driven and target\-focused. * Problem\-solving skills. * Self\-motivated and ability to show persistence. **What We Offer** * A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video. * An exciting career as an integral part of a world\-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction \- watch this short documentary about how we got our start. * An attractive salary and benefits package. * A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups. * A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Founded in 1984 by engineers for engineers, Bentley is the partner of choice for engineering firms and owner\-operators worldwide, with software that spans engineering disciplines, industry sectors, and all phases of the infrastructure lifecycle. Through our digital twin solutions, we help infrastructure professionals unlock the value of their data to transform project delivery and asset performance. www.bentley.com **Equal Opportunity Employer** Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

title: Customer Assistant
description: Joining us as a Customer Assistant is a great opportunity, whether it’s your first job and you’re looking to gain some valuable experience, or you have experience with retail and you’re looking for a new challenge, this is the start of a new career with us **About The Role** You will work onsite and report into the Assistant or Store Manager and your role could be to help on the tills, advise our customers, or work in our back shop. You will also: * Help our customers and put them at ease; whether that’s listening to find out more about them, answering questions and giving great advice on our fantastic products, recommending items they hadn’t considered or simply offering a basket \- it's the little things that make a difference * Get to know our in\-store offers and schemes and promote them \- the more info we can give our customers, the better. * Help our stores run smoothly \- this could look like ensuring we have the right products displayed on the shop floor, providing a great service on our tills, or helping with our stock in in the stock rooms * Work with other members in the team to provide a great shopping experience, ensuring the store is always clean and presentable to provide a store everyone can be proud of **What You’ll Need To Have** Full training is provided for this role, and we are looking for people who * Excel in a varied environment, working at pace * Communicate and listen effectively * Enjoy working as part of a team, promoting a collaborative team dynamic * Know that the little things make the biggest difference for customer interactions * Desire to be a proud brand ambassador for Boots and help our customers find the best products for them **It would be great if you also have** * Experience providing customer care and delivering great customer service but this is not essential. **Our Benefits** * Pension membership (PRSA) * Partial paid maternity leave * Discretionary annual bonus * Generous employee discounts * Flexible benefits scheme We have a great range of benefits in addition to the above that offer flexibility to suit you \- find out more at **boots.jobs/ireland** . Exclusions may apply, eligible roles only. *Please note, any salary estimates given on third\-party sites are not provided or endorsed by Boots and may not be accurate.* **Why Boots** At Boots, we foster a working environment where consideration and inclusivity help everyone to be themselves and reach their full potential. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, passionate about embracing the diversity of our colleagues and providing a positive and inclusive working environment for all. As the heart of everything we do at Boots, with you, we change for the better. **What's Next** If your application is successful, you'll be invited to an in\-store interview in the next 14 days. Where a role is advertised as full\-time, we are open to discussing part\-time and job share options during the application process. If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide **reasonable adjustments** to help you to be at your best.

title: Customer Assistant -  Baggot Street Upper (Permanent 30 - 35 hours)
description: **About the role** We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services. But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are. Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work \- and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work. Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date. **You will be responsible for** * Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do. * Get to know your customers and serve them with pride. * Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times. * Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition. * Keep the shop floor and back areas clean and tidy at all times. * Using the training you receive, follow department routines and processes. * Follow all company policies and adhere to Health and Safety routines. * Whilst you will have a core role, you may be asked to support your colleagues by helping in other departments. **You will need** * Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers. * Works hard for customers, your team and your department. * You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers. * Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business. * You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written. * You are reliable and a good timekeeper. * You must be smart and tidy at all times. **Whats in it for you?** We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren't limited to: * Competitive Salary * Bonus Scheme\* * Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost. * 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life. * Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F\&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.\* * Life Assurance * Pension Plan\* * Save As You Earn Scheme\* * Paid Family Leave * Bike to Work * Long Service Awards * Commuter Scheme * \*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply **About Us** Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7\.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity. Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190\+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers \- of which almost three\-quarters are small and medium enterprises \- which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1\.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food. We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards. We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best. We know life looks a little different for each of us. That's why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life\-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support. Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco\-careers.com/accessibility/ How can I let Tesco know I need additional support? Please let us know you need additional support by emailing tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

Reporting to the Head of Accounting, and working with senior stakeholders, you will be responsible for owning the month\-end process and all financials for your designated entities. **Responsibilities:** * Own the accounting and reporting for designated legal entities * Prepare accurate monthly management accounts, delivering financial analysis and variance explanation * Group reporting to include supporting group consolidations \& intercompany reconciliations * Support internal \& external audit activities and ensure compliance with Group accounting policies * Play a pivotal role in identifying operational efficiences, supporting automation and increasing controls **Experience:** * Recently qualified chartered accountant (0\-2 PQE) with experience in preparing management accounts * Big four trained in Ireland, with experience in the audit of Investment Managers/Fund Administrators/Corporate Service providers * Multi\-entity accounting experience, knowledge of various accounting standards and Power BI highly advantageous * Superior communication skills \*Only candidates who meet the aforementioned criteria will be shortlisted for the role, and who are residing in Ireland with Irish/EU passport/Stamp 4 visa \* A competitive salary \& benefits package is on offer for the ideal candidate **Contact Information:** To discuss this opportunity further and in confidence, please apply directly to this posting and Karl Byrne will reach out to discuss accordingly.

title: Finance Data Analyst Graduate Programme 2027.
description: **Location/office policy:** Molesworth Street\- 3 days per week in office **Start date:** September 2027 **Salary:** €34,500 This role is being offered as a **3\.5 year training contract** **Ready to start your career at AIB?** If you're curious, ambitious and looking for a role where you can learn, grow and make a real impact from day one, our Finance Data Analyst Graduate Programme could be the perfect fit. At AIB, we know that starting your career is a big step. That's why we've created a graduate programme that gives you meaningful work, plenty of support and opportunities to develop both professionally and personally. Over 3\.5 years, you'll rotate across different teams, gain exposure to exciting projects and develop the skills, experience and confidence needed to build a successful career. No two days will be the same! **Why join our graduate programme?** As part of the programme, you'll get the opportunity to experience different areas across Finance Data, working with a range of teams and colleagues. You'll learn on the job, contribute to real business initiatives and work alongside experienced professionals who are invested in helping you succeed. **Along The Way, You'll Also Have Opportunities To** * Build your professional network * Attend development events * Connect with senior leaders across the organisation * Learn from graduates who have already completed the programme * Explore different career paths within AIB This is more than just a graduate role. It's an opportunity to discover what you're capable of. **What You’ll Do** We’re made up of small teams where you have the chance to expand your knowledge and be heavily involved in new and ongoing projects. We view inclusion \& diversity, wellbeing and continuous learning \& development as key enablers that help our business to grow and deliver AIB’s strategic and financial objectives. As part of the programme, you will gain exposure to some of the following: * Learn the AIB Project Methodology through involvement in numerous projects including how to draft a technical specification * Data visualisation skills development from maintenance of existing dashboards to building dashboards from scratch, learning scripting language, and implementing complex data visualisation solutions. * Complete a journey of SQL competence from basic queries to complex scripts. * Exposure to working with Teradata (Relational Database Management System), other AIB systems and platforms and a knowledge of the development of Financial Data. * Data analysis and cleansing. * Gathering Data Development requirements and documenting technical specifications. * Running Financial Information Management reports. * Monitoring data visualisation batches and fixing issues. * Troubleshooting issues and implementing fixes. There will be at least 1 rotation, where we will challenge you to ensure your learning and development potential is maximised over the duration of the programme. **Skills** Graduates on this programme are given the opportunity to attend online courses in UCD to supplement on the job learning . There you will be able to develop a range of important skills, including practical data manipulation, visualisation, analytics, and machine learning. The programme assessment is project based enabling you to demonstrate your understanding and familiarity of each semester’s content in a work themed, practical way. On completion of the programme, you will receive the following from UCD: * Diploma in Data Analysis without Coding * Diploma in Database Fundamentals * Certificate in Python Programming * Diploma in Data Analytics: Visualisation * Diploma in Data Analytics: Machine Learning * Specialist Certificate in Data Analytics **What's in it for you?** **Alongside Valuable Experience And Development Opportunities, You'll Enjoy** * 21 Days annual leave \& 2 additional volunteer days * Additional AIB Bank Holidays – Good Friday \& the day after St. Stephens Day * Hybrid working, 3 days in office \& 2 working from home * Rotations across different teams * Strong emphasis on wellbeing \& work\-life balance * Structured learning \& development programme * Defined Contribution Pension Scheme * Vhi Healthcare scheme * Variable remuneration scheme **We are with you every step of the way** Starting your first professional role can feel daunting, but we'll be with you every step of the way. Every graduate is assigned a dedicated People Leader who will support your development, help you navigate challenges and encourage you to get the most from your experience. You'll also become part of a vibrant graduate community, joining fellow Finance Data graduates as well as graduates from previous intakes. Whether it's learning, networking or social events, you'll quickly build relationships that last well beyond the programme. We also offer access to a wide range of support networks and initiatives, including our Employee Assistance Programme and Mentor Her programme. **Entry Requirements** * Achieved or expected to achieve a minimum 2\.1 Honours Degree (or equivalent for universities outside of Ireland) is a prerequisite for those joining the AIB graduate programme. * Candidates must be fully authorised to work in Ireland or hold a valid work permit for the full duration of the 23\-month contract (September 2027 – March 2031\). If you are not sure about your suitability based on any aspects of the role advertised, we encourage you to please contact our Future Talent Programmes team at Grads@aib.ie for a conversation. AIB is an equal opportunities employer, and we pride ourselves on being the first bank in Ireland to receive the Investors in Diversity Gold Standard accreditation from the Irish Centre for Diversity. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees. Should you have a reasonable accommodation request please email the Talent Acquisition team at Grads@aib.ie Apply today and start shaping your future with AIB. Applications are expected to close on the **26th October** **2026** however, we encourage candidates to apply early as the programme may close sooner if demand is high. **Eligibility and Equal Opportunities** Applicants must be resident in the Republic of Ireland and be fully authorised to work, or hold a valid work permit, for the full duration of the programme. Any offer of employment will be conditional upon satisfactory evidence of the right to work in the Republic of Ireland. AIB is an equal opportunities employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. **Disclaimer** Unsolicited CV’s sent to AIB by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this position. AIB operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our recruitment partners.

title: Finance Grad Programme 2027 - ACA / ACCA Accredited
description: Ryanair, over our 40 year history has grown to become Europe's largest airline group connecting more guests across more routes than any other European carrier. We are a fast\-paced, ambitious and innovative company, offering exciting career opportunities across aviation, technology, operations and support functions. Now is a fantastic time to join as we look to grow to over 800 aircraft and 300m guests within the next 8 years. **Job Description** Looking for a challenging and rewarding Grad Programme? Do you want to work for an industry leader where career progression is a given if you work hard and are dedicated? Then join the **2026 Ryanair Grad Programme** , the best available programme in Europe! We have grad programmes across our entire business where you will get the chance to rotate across teams (and across our network) in your preferred dept allowing you to gain transferable skills and a deep understanding of Ryanair and its operations, to set you up on a career path to the skies! Across the 3\.5 years of the programme, our grads will get continued mentorship from our senior leadership team, will be part of a structured programme providing you trips, tips and insights into Europe’s largest airline which will allow you to develop while we grow to be The World’s Largest Airline. **The Programme** Ryanair have partnered with both ACA and ACCA to provide a three and a half year training contract in the unique environment of Europe’s largest airline group. Throughout your time here you will rotate through our Finance department (and for the adventurous at heart maybe even a stint abroad in one of subsidiary airlines!) all while being supported through the process of gaining an internationally recognised accounting qualification. Areas of the business you will spend a six month rotation in include: * Fuel/Insurance * FP \& A * Banking * Internal Audit * Tax * Management Accounting * Financial Reporting **The Application Process** We are big on motivation here in Ryanair and want to hear from Grads who have a genuine interest in working for Ryanair. As part of the application, please put in your preferences as to which department you’re keen to work in the most but our Talent Team will review your application and may reach out if they feel you are more suitable for other departments Applications will remain open until **31st January 2026** But we recommend getting your application in earlier as like our aircraft we like to be on\-time! Everyone we hire at Ryanair needs to show the skills and behaviours that have helped us to achieve our growth over the last 40\+ years and we expect candidates to demonstrate a hardworking and entrepreneurial spirit during the interview process. If we decide to progress your application you will be invited for an phonecall (so if an Irish number is calling, make sure you answer), followed by a Microsoft Teams interview. As part of the process, all grads must come to Dublin for a Face to Face interview. To ensure you are putting your best foot forward, please make sure that you pay attention to the application and ensure that all information supplied is accurate. In the cover letter please state why you want to join the Ryanair Graduate Programme and let us know about which areas that you are particularly interested in working in. **Qualifications** * Studied a relevant degree programme (Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics etc) and either secured a 2\.1 or above or be on track to * Must have graduated/ finished university no earlier than 2024 * Hold the unrestricted right to live and work in Ireland and travel freely throughout the network. * Strong analytical ability to drive efficiency, quality and continuous improvements * Ability to work in a pressurised and fast paced environment * Strong organisational and interpersonal skills * The ability to work on own initiative * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * PC Skills (Word, Excel, Power point etc) * Good sense of humour and doesn't take themselves too seriously!!!! **Additional Information** * Competitive salary that increases in Year 2! * Discounted and unlimited travel to over 250 destinations * Defined Contribution Pension Scheme – Matched up to 5% or €5,000 * Death in Service Benefit – Up to 2 times of annual basic salary * 20 Days Annual Leave – Increasing to 22 days after 12 months and 25 days after 3 years of continuous service. * Option for up to 5 additional unpaid leave days per year * Cycle 2 Work Scheme * Unrivalled career progression

title: Finance Graduate Pathways
description: **Job Description** The daa Finance Graduate Programme is a three\-year programme designed for ambitious entry level graduates who want to build a career at the heart of a dynamic, global business. You'll gain exposure to the key finance functions that help power one of Ireland's most important transport hubs, while working in a fast\-paced environment where innovation, automation, and digital transformation are shaping the future of finance. Graduates will join the Early Careers Community, a network of interns, apprentices, and second\-year graduates, offering opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build professional connections across the business. You will join our Finance team from day one and remain with the wider finance team throughout your graduate journey. This allows you to develop deep technical expertise, build strong stakeholder relationships, take ownership of meaningful projects, and see the impact of your work over time. As part of a global airport and travel retail group operating across 13 countries, you'll gain experience in a business that connects millions of people, supports international trade, and invests in sustainable growth. Working alongside experienced finance professionals, you'll gain exposure across areas such as Shared Services, Group Reporting, Forecasting, Budgeting, Tax, and Commercial Finance, contributing to projects that drive business performance and continuous improvement. Alongside your role, you'll be supported in pursuing a professional accounting qualification giving you the skills, experience, and foundations to build a successful and future\-focused career in finance. **Responsibilities** **What will you work on:** As a Finance Graduate, you’ll embark on a dynamic three\-year journey designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of our business and the finance function. In Year 1, you'll build a strong foundation across key areas of the finance function, supported by a dedicated mentor who will help guide your development: Throughout the year, you will gain exposure to a range of key areas, including: * Shared Services (Limerick): Gain hands\-on experience in core financial operations and end\-to\-end finance processes. * Commercial Operations: Develop insight into the financial drivers behind our diverse commercial businesses. * Forecasting \& Budgeting: Support planning activities, including forecasting, budgeting, and capital investment processes. * daa International: Explore the financial operations and strategies that support our international business. In Years 2 And 3, You Will Deepen Your Expertise Within a Specialist Finance Team While Continuing To Broaden Your Understanding Of The Wider Business. Supported By Ongoing Development Opportunities, You Will Gain Exposure To a Range Of Key Areas, Including * Group Reporting: Support the preparation of consolidated financial statements and management reporting. * Tax: Assist with tax compliance, reporting, and planning activities. * Cost \& Efficiency: Contribute to initiatives that drive value, improve efficiency, and support business performance. **Qualifications** **Do you have what it takes?** We’re Looking For Curious Minds And Bold Thinkers Ready To Shape The Future Of Airport Technology. To Thrive In This Programme, You Should * Hold (or be expecting) a 2\.1 degree or higher in a relevant field who are passionate about building a career in finance * Demonstrate adaptability, responding positively to change and thriving in dynamic and evolving environments. * Show an innovative mindset, seeking opportunities to improve processes, challenge conventional thinking, and solve problems creatively. * Apply critical thinking, using evidence, insight, and sound judgement to make informed decisions. * Exhibit learning agility, learning quickly, embracing feedback, and continuously developing new skills and capabilities. * Be strong collaborators, building effective relationships and working successfully across teams and stakeholders to achieve shared goals. * Align with daa's values and purpose, sharing our commitment to enabling business, connecting lives, and building a sustainable future. **What We Are Offering You** ? As a daa Finance Graduate, you will enjoy a comprehensive package of benefits designed to support your growth and reward your performance. As you work towards your finance qualification, you’ll benefit from a structured development journey that sets you up for long\-term success. **Benefits Include** * Competitive salary with a performance\-related bonus to reward your impact * Support to pursue a finance qualification, including dedicated study leave * Opportunities to shape the future of finance \- from automating reporting to leveraging AI tools and driving innovation across the organisation * Projects across daa’s business units \- e.g daa International, ARI (Retail) and Commercial Operation

title: Financial Analyst II - Business Partnering

description: Our client, a well\-established financial services firm based in Ballsbridge, is seeking an experienced **Financial Services Administrator** to join their team. title: Fuel ETRP Rotational Graduate Program 2027

facilities, premises and external grounds to a high standard. * Carry out routine inspections, repairs and maintenance and report any defects, damage or issues requiring specialist attention. * Ensure all work is completed to a high standard of workmanship, within agreed timescales and in accordance with management instructions. * Ensure the correct and safe use, maintenance and storage of tools, title: General Operator
description: CEL Critical Power is a global leader in delivering advanced data centre and industrial power solutions. Main Duties: * Comply with CEL's Environmental, Health and Safety Procedures: * Using hand tools and equipment safely and as trained * Perform manual handling tasks safely, including lifting and moving components (up to 23 kg) * Maintain a clean, organised, and audit‑ready workstation * Ensure scrap and waste materials are stored safely prior to collection * Follow the Company's Quality Growth** We offer structured career development, professional training, and leadership opportunities, ensuring long\-term career progression.

title: Graduate AI software engineer
description: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all\-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent\-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. **A few examples of your responsibilities** * **Build AI\-powered product experiences.** Work with product teams to identify high\-impact opportunities where AI can transform the user experience for millions—and then build these transformative solutions. Drive the process from possibility to production, delivering code that’s robust, reproducible, and built for scale. * **Amplify your impact with AI.** Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability. * **Master your toolkit.** Work across diverse stacks with end\-to\-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends. * **Build software that matters.** Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale. * **Simplify relentlessly.** Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain. **What we look for** * **Reasoning ability.** Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. * **Drive.** You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. * **Team spirit.** You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. * **Proficiency in English.** You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. **What we offer** * **Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.** You’ll work in small, result\-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. * **An exceptional opportunity for growth.** We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. * **All. These. Benefits.** Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top\-of\-the\-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. * **A flexible start date and part\-time options.** You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part\-time, transitioning to full\-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education. * **Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.** Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. **Commitment \& contract** Permanent or fixed\-term. Full\-time. **Location** Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries. **The selection process** In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self\-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. **Before you apply** If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long\-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Graduate Development Programme 2027

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 130 countries worldwide. Our team is dynamic, innovative, and client\-focused, supported by an inclusive and fun company culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result, our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world. **Job Description** Our Graduate Development Programme (GDP) is a structured learning environment providing graduates with the skills and experience they need to be a successful consultant. Over the two\-year programme, you will receive market\-leading training through our technical training academy as well as a range of soft\-skills and on\-the\-job learning. The GDP is blended with external qualifications and professional accreditation including SCSI , APM, CIOB and ICE to ensure you become an industry\-leading professional. In your role, you will support the project management commissions, taking responsibility for effectively delivering a vast range of tasks to the highest quality standard. Turner \& Townsend Confidential **Cost Management (Quantity Surveying)** Cost management is vital in delivering the best value to our clients and maximising their return on investment. We do so by: * Leveraging technology and digital ways of working * Implementing robust governance frameworks for successful digital initiatives * Streamlining project execution with advance technology and connected data * Organising project data and enabling automation. The graduates we recruit are strategic, analytical thinkers who see solutions where others see challenges. They come from diverse backgrounds, but usually have a strong degree, a genuine enthusiasm for how the world works, and a love for learning on the job. **Knowledge, Skills and Experience** * Excellent communications skills * Problem Solver * Commitment to making a difference * Driven by quality * Exceeding expectations * Collaborative * Commercial thinking * Passion for the construction industry * Desire to learn **Qualifications** A relevant degree in a discipline aligned with the role you're applying for. This includes Irish and EEA nationals, as well as individuals holding Stamp 4 or other long\-term residency permissions that allow full access to the Irish labour market. **Additional Information** Our people share our Purpose and Values. We actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.​ If this sounds like a challenge you’d like to hear more about, please submit an application for our recruitment team to review. ​ Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/​ Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner \& Townsend and our exciting future projects: Twitter Instagram LinkedIn It is strictly against Turner \& Townsend policy for candidates to pay any fee in relation to our recruitment process. title: Hydrometric Field Service Tech
description: **Company Description** NVM Limited is an Irish\-owned, ISO 9001:2015 certified company specializing in geotechnical, hydrological, and environmental monitoring services for the construction sector, government agencies, local authorities, and pharmaceutical industries. The company focuses on delivering high\-quality services and supplying instrumentation designed for demanding environmental data collection and processing. Since 2004, NVM has built a reliable team of environmental service professionals with expertise in instrumentation installation, telemetry, field service, and data collection. As a Channel Partner for OTT Hydromet, NVM provides sales and service in Ireland and Northern Ireland for a comprehensive product range covering water quality, quantity, telemetry, and precipitation measurement. The company’s work supports accurate environmental measurement and monitoring of critical conditions. **Role Description** The Hydrometric Field Service Tech is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Drogheda. This role involves installing, maintaining, and calibrating hydrometric and environmental monitoring instruments at field sites, including water level, flow, and weather stations. The technician will perform regular site visits to inspect equipment performance, carry out troubleshooting and basic repairs, and ensure accurate data collection and transmission via telemetry systems. Responsibilities include documenting field activities, preparing service reports, following safety procedures, and coordinating with project managers and clients to support monitoring programs. The role also includes occasional participation in equipment upgrades, system commissioning, and assisting with training or guidance for colleagues and clients on proper use of instrumentation. **Qualifications** * Candidates should possess skills in field instrumentation installation, calibration, and maintenance for hydrometric or environmental monitoring systems. * Candidates should possess skills in data collection, data validation, and basic data analysis related to environmental and hydrological measurements. * Candidates should possess skills in telemetry systems, remote monitoring technologies, and troubleshooting communication issues between field stations and central systems. * Candidates should possess skills in technical documentation, report writing, and clear communication of field findings to project teams and clients. * Candidates should possess practical skills in using hand tools, electrical connections, and safe work practices in outdoor and sometimes challenging site conditions. * Relevant qualifications such as a technical diploma or degree in environmental science, engineering, hydrology, or a related field are beneficial. * Experience in fieldwork, working in all weather conditions, and a full valid driving license are advantageous. * Strong problem\-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to work independently and as part of a team are important for success in this role.

title: Infrastructure & Engineering Graduate Pathways
description: Job Description As a daa Infrastructure Graduate, you will help deliver the infrastructure that keeps Ireland connected to the world. From expanding airfields and terminals to delivering major civil engineering and sustainability projects, you will contribute to some of Ireland's most significant infrastructure developments across Dublin and Cork Airports. Working in a live operational environment, you will gain exposure to complex projects that support future growth, enhance connectivity, and improve the passenger experience. Graduates will join the Early Careers Community, a network of interns, apprentices, and second\-year graduates, offering opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build professional connections across the business. Over this two\-year fixed\-term contract, you'll work within our Infrastructure team, contributing to major projects across Dublin and Cork Airports, including airfield and terminal expansions, civil engineering works, transport infrastructure, and sustainability initiatives. Whether you are contributing to airfield developments, terminal expansions, transport infrastructure, or sustainability initiatives, you will play a meaningful role in projects that have a lasting impact. If you are passionate about engineering, innovation, and creating infrastructure that connects people and businesses around the world, the daa Infrastructure Graduate role offers the perfect foundation for an exciting and rewarding career. Responsibilities As a daa Infrastructure Graduate, you will continue to build expertise within your specialism, gaining hands\-on experience in areas which may include project delivery, strategy, advisory services, contracts, programme controls, governance, health and safety, quality assurance, and technical services. Working in a live operational aviation environment, you will collaborate with consultants, contractors, and stakeholders across the business, contributing to capital projects that are shaping the future of Ireland's aviation infrastructure. Areas you may gain exposure includes: * Civil Airfield Development \- Contributing to major airfield infrastructure projects, including Ireland's first airport runway underpass, while developing your technical and problem\-solving skills on complex engineering challenges. * Piers \& Terminal Development \- Supporting the design and delivery of terminal and pier developments that enhance capacity and create a world\-class passenger experience. * Access \& Connectivity Improvements \- Working alongside Planning and Strategy teams on projects that improve airport accessibility, strengthen connectivity, and support long\-term growth. * Sustainability \& Safety \- Helping ensure safety and sustainability are embedded in every stage of infrastructure development, supporting daa's environmental ambitions and future\-ready infrastructure goals. * Qualifications **Do you have what it takes?** We’re looking for ambitious graduates ready to shape the future of infrastructure. To succeed in these entry level graduate roles, you should: * Hold (or be expecting) a 2\.1 degree or higher in Civil/Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Quantity Surveying, or a related Construction discipline. * Demonstrate a strong understanding of engineering, construction, or infrastructure principles gained through your studies or project work. * Bring strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate information and make sound decisions. * Be naturally curious and motivated, with a desire to learn, develop, and take on new challenges. * Demonstrate adaptability, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic and evolving environments. * Show an innovative mindset, seeking opportunities to improve processes, challenge conventional thinking, and solve problems creatively. * Exhibit learning agility, embracing feedback, and continuously developing new skills and capabilities. * Be strong collaborators, building effective relationships and working successfully across teams and stakeholders to achieve shared goals. * Align with daa's values and purpose, sharing our commitment to enabling business, connecting lives, and building a sustainable future. **What We Are Offering You?**As a daa Infrastructure Graduate, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your growth, reward your impact, and help you thrive \- professionally and personally. From global exposure to wellbeing perks, this programme is your launchpad to a standout career in aviation infrastructure. Programme benefits include: * Competitive salary with a performance\-related bonus to reward your impact * A structured development pathway, including a 12\-week Engineers Ireland\-accredited Airport Planning \& Design course, alongside expert\-led knowledge\-sharing sessions throughout the year. * Exposure to major infrastructure and capital projects, giving you the opportunity to contribute to projects of varying scale, complexity, and strategic importance. * Hands\-on experience with industry\-leading technologies, including BIM, GIS and cloud\-based project delivery platforms used across large\-scale infrastructure programmes. * The opportunity to build technical expertise in civil and construction engineering, project planning, design coordination, and site delivery. * A strong foundation for professional accreditation, supported by experienced mentors, continuous learning opportunities, and real\-world project experience.

If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. **Use of AI Statement** At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. Bank Holiday responsibilities are also shared equally amongst the veterinary team.
